sn11.18:1.3: bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave sakko devānamindo mātaliṃ saṅgāhakaṃ āmantesi:
sn11.18:1.4: yojehi samma mātali, sahassayuttaṃ ājaññarathaṃ. uyyānabhūmiṃ gacchāma subhūmiṃ dassanāyāti.
sn11.18:1.5: evaṃ bhaddantavāti kho bhikkhave mātali saṅgāhako sakkassa devānamindassa paṭissutvā sahassayuttaṃ ājaññarathaṃ yojetvā sakkassa devānamindassa paṭivedesi:
sn11.18:1.6: yutto kho te mārisa, sahassayutto ājaññaratho.
sn11.18:1.8: atha kho bhikkhave sakko devānamindo vejayantapāsādā orohanto pañjaliko sudaṃ puthuddisā namassati.
sn11.18:1.9: atha kho bhikkhave mātalisaṅgāhako sakkaṃ devānamindaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi:
